text:
jamie: FYI saw a ~20% drop in prefix cache hit-rate after last runtime rollout (kernel v2.7). Metric: prefix_cache.hitrate over last 6h. Baseline was ~82%, now ~62%.
ryan: ouch. any indication if it's batching vs kv lookup slowdown?
sara: I ran a short profiler on a repro workload — kernel selection path spends more time in post-attn serialization and our KV lookup latency median increased 2.1x. suspecting an extra normalize/canonicalize step in the RPC path.
jamie: repro script attached in thread (ran on dedicated test pool). Streaming traces show retries where the client resends with streaming=true but misses the cache-opt-in header on retry.
kevin: that could explain misses: our cache keying requires header "x-rw-cache-opt" + prompt fingerprint. If retry drops header, second attempt bypasses server prefix-match and warms cold.
maria: which client version? I think SDK 0.9.12 did a header canonicalization change to fold header names into lowercase to satisfy some proxies. Maybe that interacts with our server header parsing edgecases.
jamie: confirmed: 0.9.12 on retries uses a new HTTP lib path that strips non-standard headers for ephemeral retry requests. Logged header set before send and on retry — header gone.
ryan: so two problems: server kernel change increased baseline lookup latency, and client retry behavior induces more cold-cache warms -> combined effect bigger than either alone.
sara: profiling notes: KV lookup microbench (1000 reps) pre-rollout median 4.8ms, post-rollout 11.2ms. The extra 6ms correlates with additional header-parsing/acl check we added to support new routing policy. That check runs before KV key normalization.
kevin: running a quick thought: move ACL + routing pre-check after KV lookup if it doesn't influence keying or add a fast-path that uses a precomputed ACL bit in request metadata.
maria: short-term mitigation: mark SDK retry path to preserve custom headers (0.9.13 patch). Also we can make server accept cache-opt header in body as fallback: e.g., add optional json field "cache_opt": "prefetch" so streaming retried frames can include it.
jamie: agree. Also we should add an invariant test in eng-runtime e2e: ask clients to run a streaming+retry flow and assert header preserved.
ryan: ops-bot: can we roll back kernel v2.7 to v2.6 on a subset of pool to confirm delta?
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolled back runtime pool "staging-pool-b" to v2.6 at 16:02 UTC for 10 nodes. Will collect same workload.
kevin: thanks. if hitrate returns to baseline on rollback then root cause split is confirmed.
sara: extra datapoint: when we force client not to retry (simulate no-retry), hit-rate stays ~80% even on v2.7 for short sequences. So retries amplify.
maria: proposed release plan: 1) SDK patch to keep headers on retry (0.9.13 hotfix) 2) server fast-path to avoid extra canonicalization for cache keying (eng-runtime PR) 3) e2e test and metric alert that watches prefix_cache.hitrate drop > 10% over 1h.
jamie: also update docs/devex: add note about using header vs body for idempotent cache hints and mention streaming edge cases.
ryan: small follow-up: consider making cache key include an explicit "cache_hint_id" client-generated token so retries always carry same key even if headers get dropped. That would be resilient.
kevin: can implement as SDK add: when client sees streaming retry possibility, generate short LRU token and include in body. Server accepts that for keying if present. Low-risk.
sara: I'll open two PRs: one to move ACL check to post-kv-fastpath and another to add a short-circuit path for cache keys. Jamie can you add the e2e test skeleton?
jamie: on it. I'll also add telemetry events: report when header missing but body cache_hint present, and vice versa.
maria: timeline: aim for SDK hotfix within 6 hours, server fast-path + tests in next 24-48h. Rollforward after confirming staging pool metrics.
kevin: thanks team. small ops note: watch batching heuristics — if KV lookup latency stays higher we might need smaller batch sizes to preserve p95 latency.
jamie: noted. will run a sweep of batching param grid and post results in #eng-runtime tomorrow. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
sdk-deploy-bot: SDK 0.9.13 hotfix build queued (build-2749). Will post artifact link when ready. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: Staging pool metrics back in 2h, will post hitrate and kv-latency graphs.
jamie: thanks — appreciate the quick triage.
